audience: shops and businesses who book on-demand deliveries with Lalamove

useCases.title: Check which vehicle types a city offers
useCases.text: The AI lists the cities of your market with vehicle types such as MOTORCYCLE or CAR, their size and load, and the special requests each vehicle accepts.

useCases.title: Track a delivery and see its driver
useCases.text: The AI reads an order's status, proof of delivery and share link, and the driver's name and live location when the driver is on the way.

useCases.title: Get a price quote for a delivery
useCases.text: The AI prices a delivery with a pickup, up to 15 drop-offs and a vehicle type, and returns the price breakdown and distance. Nothing is ordered or charged.

useCases.title: Place a delivery order from a quotation
useCases.text: After you see and accept the price, the AI places the order from the quotation. It charges your prepaid wallet and a driver is dispatched.

useCases.title: Add a priority fee, change the driver or cancel
useCases.text: The AI adds a higher priority fee to attract a driver, asks for a new driver, or cancels an order when Lalamove's rules allow it.
